title: Charge coherent reset overlap across the complete circuit
statement: For explicit beta=qTr(Pcode tau),simultaneous data/program conjugation makes the COMPLETE circuit even in reset coherence. Paired4,-4 cancellation removes first derivative; error<=0.441nu p+3beta with unchanged rank-bounded cost. No beta-from-Delta inference.

requires: Fixed finite-dimensional stationary memoryless source; data/reference and every fresh program independent conditional on ONE fixed source. Known accessible output-register type, trusted qutrit/ancilla gates, coherent whole-register SWAPs and quantum memory. No purification, inverse oracle, hidden flag, unknown eigenbasis or reusable decoder is supplied. Exact erasure requires tau V=0 on the whole occupied success code. No lower bound on nonzero sigma eigenvalues. Analyze s*=nu/(8r) low-weight flags and soft threshold; no unknown support measurement is implemented. Coherent overlap uses paired cancellation and whole-circuit sign parity.
